dates: ISO YYYY-MM-DD; full trading calendar, no compressed gaps
contract_lists: JSON arrays of distinct exact contract codes; expected from audited lifecycle; count equality alone insufficient
booleans: CSV True/False; no numeric or truthy-string shortcuts
training: 250 preceding consecutive trading sessions only; columns [1,r5,abs(r5),rv20,v5]; rank 5; source-local; warmup retained with null u5
rv20: std(ddof=1) of 20 daily simple index returns ending t * sqrt(245)
pool: arithmetic mean of IC/IM corresponding g5,r5,rv20,v5, both required; residual fit on pooled features
ownership: data_manager derives all actual market datasets; research consumer validates and later evaluates candidates
